name: James Hannigan
role: Medora resident; dance manager, school board president, partner of Bob Roberts
bio: James Hannigan was one of Medora's oldest residents and, until January 1886, a partner of Bob Roberts. In 1884 he advertised a rattlesnake-bite cure, decorated the hall for a July ball, managed dances at Roberts' hall at Thanksgiving and Christmas, and in late November was elected president of the school board. He and his wife lived at the Cantonment and then in one of the brick cottages, and he shot with the gun club in 1885. In March 1886 he moved with his family to Bozeman to go into business.
